thread:
Nora: sharing a compact mock for the API keys list and a proposed tiny flow for revoke + undo. main concerns: accidental revoke on mobile and discoverability of "saved only once" for new keys. mock: https://design.redwood.local/mock/keys-compact.png

Ben: compact rows look good. mobile worry: overflow menu too close to primary touch area. suggest increasing hit target and moving revoke into a separate danger section.

Sam: +1. keyboard users need a clear focus ring on the copy button. when revoke happens, prefer inline soft banner with undo instead of modal. less context switching.

Irina: accessibility note: inline banner should use role="status" and aria-live="polite" if non-blocking. if revoke disables client traffic immediately, use assertive. Also ensure color contrast on the small yellow warning.

Nora: copy sketches: "Create API key" (primary), "Download key" (on first create), empty state: "No keys yet  create one to start calling the API." microcopy under CTA: "Limit by model or route later."

Ben: regarding download: show a one-time panel with big CTA "Download key" and a secondary "I saved it" so folks confirm. consider only showing persist panel if they didn't click download within 20s.

Sam: testing checklist: focus trap for drawer, keyboard copy button announced, undo works from toast and from inline banner, mobile bottom-sheet respects confirmations.

Design-bot: automated checks: focus-trap: FAIL on nested modals; color contrast: WARN for hint text; button hit area small on mobile: FAIL. Uploaded updated artboard: keys-compact-v2.fig (https://design.redwood.local/file/keys-compact-v2)
